outcome: Type of surgical management (stent implantation, coarctectomy, balloon valvuloplasty)
cohort: Seven neonates who were the smaller twin of monochorionic pregnancies complicated by selective fetal growth restriction and diagnosed with critical coarctation of the aorta.
finding: Critical coarctation of the aorta specifically affects the smaller twin of growth-discordant monochorionic twin pairs, and stent implantation is a feasible bridging therapy to surgery in these low birth weight neonates.
